name: evirest
description: HTTP/REST APIを手軽に送信・検証できるAPIテスター（Chrome拡張機能）

scripts.zip: pnpm vendor && pnpm check && mkdir -p dist && V=$(node -p "require('./manifest.json').version") && rm -f dist/evirest-$V.zip && zip -r -X dist/evirest-$V.zip manifest.json background.js app.html app.css app.js icons vendor -x '*.DS_Store' && echo dist/evirest-$V.zip
